fusions.name: Puffball Burst
fusions.desc: Slams the ground and bursts a cloud of spores, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles with a 60% chance to leave each [Diseased] for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Soft Rot Smash
fusions.desc: A blow that needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, dealing 9 damage and leaving the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hardened Bracket
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 10 seconds. You also carry 15% poison resistance.

fusions.name: Into Every Crack
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. Your armour rises by 5%.
